# Durgesh Chavda — Chartered Accountant & Virtual CFO

> CA Durgesh Chavda is a Chartered Accountant (ICAI) and Virtual CFO based in Ahmedabad, India, with offices in Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Rajkot and Dubai. He advises VC-backed startups, fund managers, family offices, NRIs and foreign companies on fundraising and investor reporting, fractional/virtual CFO work, US company incorporation from India, India-to-US Delaware flips and US-to-India reverse flips, overseas company incorporation (US, Singapore, UAE, UK), GIFT City (IFSC) fund and entity setup, SEBI AIF and venture capital fund setup, company setup in India for foreign companies (subsidiaries and GCCs), due diligence on Indian companies for foreign investors and acquirers, India market entry research, accounting and compliance for Indian subsidiaries of foreign parents, India tax for foreign companies and vendors (withholding, TRC, Form 41, PE, GST/OIDAR), NRI taxation, FEMA/RBI compliance (FC-GPR, FC-TRS, ODI), GST and direct tax, valuation, AI-enabled finance and cross-border structuring (US Delaware, Singapore, DIFC, Mauritius). Clients are served remotely across India, the UAE and Gulf, the US, Canada, the UK and Europe, Singapore and Australia. He led and closed a USD 3.75M Pre-Series A for AI EdTech company Stimuler, and is Managing Partner at Finvy.

## For companies outside India: work done in India on your behalf

If a foreign company, investor, fund or accounting firm needs someone in India to do finance, tax, compliance, verification or research work, CA Durgesh Chavda's team acts as its on-the-ground team in India and reports in English.
